global.whyImportant: 此次袭击加剧了黑海地区的紧张局势，并对当地能源运输安全构成威胁。

china.titleZh: 最后通牒：欧盟向中国施压，要求贸易谈判取得实质进展

china.titleZh: 美国公司ArriVent股价暴跌，凸显中国生物技术全球化扩张风险
china.summaryZh: 美国生物制药公司ArriVent因其从中国引进的抗癌药物在三期临床试验中失败，导致股价暴跌近47%。这一挫折凸显了中国生物技术公司在海外市场扩张时面临的研发与合规挑战。

Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday. china.titleZh: 中国女子买下近200个停车位转手倒卖获利，引发邻居诉讼

china.summaryZh: 国际燃气联盟（IGU）理事会及“赋能可持续未来”峰会将于本月在香港召开。会议将汇集跨行业领袖，共同探讨地缘政治不确定性背景下的全球能源价格趋势与能源安全问题。
china.whyImportant: 此次峰会为全球能源行业提供了一个交流平台，有助于应对当前复杂的能源供应与安全挑战。

usa.titleZh: 一名俄罗斯实验室技术员死亡后，美国和世卫组织向莫斯科施压要求说明鼠疫情况

watch.titleZh: 马来西亚的缅甸赌注？遣返行动为外交铺路
watch.summaryZh: 马来西亚在缅甸领导人到访前遣返缅甸国民，此举被视为东盟国家寻求改善与缅甸军政府关系的最新尝试。分析人士指出，这种双边接触的增加引发了外界对东盟结束缅甸内战努力可能被削弱的担忧。
watch.whyImportant: 此举显示出东盟内部在处理缅甸危机时，正从集体施压转向更复杂的双边外交博弈。

items.title: Flydubai attack investigation widens as alleged hijacker’s training in New Zealand scrutinised
items.summary: Hamam al-Hammami spent 175 days in New Zealand until May 2019, as Australian Jewish group calls for full investigation into his time in Melbourne New Zealand authorities have launched their own investigation into the flydubai co-pilot who allegedly tried to hijack an Israel-bound plane, after police confirmed he underwent flight training there about a year after he abandoned a degree in Australia. Disaster was narrowly averted on 30 September when passengers and crew intervened to stop the alleged attempt of the co-pilot, Hamam al-Hammami, 29, to take control of a flight to Tel Aviv with 182 people onboard. items.titleZh: 迪拜航空袭击调查扩大，涉嫌劫机者的纽西兰飞行训练受审查
items.summaryZh: 纽西兰当局正调查一名涉嫌试图劫持飞往以色列航班的迪拜航空副驾驶。该男子曾于2019年在纽西兰接受飞行训练，目前警方正对其背景进行深入审查。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了对航空安全及飞行员背景审查程序的国际关注。

items.title: Israel marks 3 years since October 7 attack that sparked war in Gaza
items.summary: Israel marked the third anniversary of Hamas’ October 7 attack on Wednesday with silent tributes, new strikes on Gaza and intense political debate, weeks before elections in which the country’s deadliest day will be front and centre. At the site of the Nova music festival, where Hamas militants in trucks and paragliders opened fire around dawn on October 7, 2023, family members bowed their heads in silence – although at least one instead put on techno music in tribute to the fallen. items.titleZh: 以色列纪念10月7日袭击事件三周年，该事件引发了加沙战争
items.summaryZh: 以色列通过默哀和悼念活动纪念哈马斯袭击三周年。在即将到来的选举前夕，该国政界围绕战争影响展开了激烈辩论。
items.whyImportant: 三周年纪念凸显了该冲突对以色列社会造成的深远创伤及持续的政治影响。

items.title: Naval drone hits oil tanker off Russian resort city Sochi, triggering massive blaze
items.summary: Russian officials said a Liberian-flagged tanker was attacked and a crew of 23 Indian nationals rescued An oil tanker off Russia’s Black Sea coast was struck by a naval drone, triggering a huge fire and black smoke cloud that blanketed parts of the resort city of Sochi, Russia’s transport ministry has said. The transport ministry said a Liberian-flagged tanker had been attacked and that “crude oil is burning openly in the waters of the Black Sea”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 海军无人机袭击俄罗斯索契度假城市附近的油轮，引发大火
items.summaryZh: 一艘悬挂利比里亚国旗的油轮在黑海遭海军无人机袭击，导致船上起火并冒出浓烟。船上23名印度籍船员已被救出。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击加剧了黑海地区的紧张局势，并对当地能源运输安全构成威胁。

items.titleZh: 侦探在法庭上回忆发现博·拉马尔-康登涉嫌谋杀受害者时情绪崩溃
items.summaryZh: 前警官博·拉马尔-康登被控于2024年2月在悉尼谋杀两名男子。一名侦探在法庭作证时，因描述发现受害者遗体的过程而情绪失控。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉及前警官且案情严重，在澳大利亚社会引起了广泛关注。

items.titleZh: 昆士兰州一名男子因三个月大的儿子死于“严重内伤”被控谋杀
items.summaryZh: 一名28岁的昆士兰州男子因其三个月大的儿子在医院死亡而被控谋杀。该婴儿此前因严重内伤入院并接受了生命维持治疗。
items.whyImportant: 这起悲剧引发了公众对儿童保护和家庭暴力问题的关注。

items.title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
items.summary: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.
items.titleZh: 10月7日哈马斯袭击中被毁的基布兹居民正努力重建家园
items.summaryZh: 在尼尔奥兹基布兹遭受袭击三年后，部分幸存者选择返回居住。他们正面临如何重建社区的艰难抉择。
items.whyImportant: 该报道反映了受灾社区在经历惨痛袭击后，试图恢复正常生活的艰难历程。

items.title: Three years of Israel’s genocide in Gaza: In numbers
items.summary: Three years of attacks has devastated Gaza, killing tens of thousands, destroying homes, and collapsing basic services.
items.titleZh: 以色列在加沙的三年战争：数据盘点
items.summaryZh: 过去三年的冲突给加沙造成了毁灭性打击，导致数万人死亡。当地住房被毁，基本公共服务体系已全面崩溃。
items.whyImportant: 这些数据揭示了长期冲突对加沙地区造成的人道主义灾难。

items.title: Israelis pause to mark October 7 Hamas-attack anniversary
items.summary: Israelis gathered at memorials to mark the moment the Hamas-led attack began on October 7, 2023.
items.titleZh: 以色列人停下脚步纪念哈马斯袭击三周年
items.summaryZh: 以色列民众聚集在纪念碑前，悼念2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击开始的时刻。全国各地举行了多场纪念活动。
items.whyImportant: 纪念活动反映了该事件在以色列国民心中留下的深刻集体记忆。

items.title: Former bishop sentenced to more than six years in prison for sexually abusing young Aboriginal men
items.summary: Christopher Alan Saunders becomes highest-ranked Catholic in Australia convicted of sexual abuse over his time as member of clergy Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A former high-ranking Catholic known for hosting boozy parties will spend at least four and a half years behind bars for sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men. items.titleZh: 前主教因性侵原住民青年被判处六年多监禁
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚前布鲁姆教区主教克里斯托弗·艾伦·桑德斯因性侵两名原住民青年，被判处至少四年半的监禁。他因犯下13项性犯罪罪名，成为澳大利亚历史上被判性侵罪的最高级别天主教神职人员。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉案人员的宗教地位及受害者身份而引发社会对教会内部性丑闻及司法公正的广泛关注。

items.title: US stock market hits all-time high as investors continue to bet on AI
items.summary: The benchmark S&P 500 is up 14 percent this year despite elevated oil prices and US government debt sell-off.
items.titleZh: 受人工智能投资热潮推动，美国股市创下历史新高
items.summaryZh: 尽管面临油价上涨和美国政府债务抛售的压力，标普500指数今年仍上涨了14%。投资者对人工智能领域的持续看好是推动市场创下新高的主要动力。
items.whyImportant: 股市表现反映了市场对人工智能技术长期增长潜力的信心，尽管宏观经济环境存在不确定性。

Maros Sefcovic, the EU’s trade chief, will meet his Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao on Thursday and Friday – three months after their last encounter in Brussels, when the Europeans set an October deadline for signs of a rebalancing in the trading relationship. items.titleZh: 最后通牒：欧盟向中国施压，要求贸易谈判取得实质进展
items.summaryZh: 欧盟贸易专员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇将于周四前往北京，与中国商务部部长王文涛进行为期两天的密集谈判。欧盟此前已设定10月为贸易关系再平衡的最后期限，但目前对谈判结果持谨慎态度。
items.whyImportant: 此次谈判是中欧贸易关系的关键节点，直接影响双方在贸易平衡及市场准入方面的后续政策走向。

items.title: US firm ArriVent’s plunge shows risks facing China’s biotech expansion into global markets
items.summary: US firm ArriVent BioPharma’s shares plummeted after a late-stage trial failure involving a cancer drug licensed from China, a setback that analysts said highlighted the challenges facing Chinese biotech companies expanding overseas. New York-listed ArriVent closed down nearly 47 per cent on Tuesday after reporting that its cancer treatment firmonertinib failed to meet its main goal in a phase 3 trial. Firmonertinib was originally developed by Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals to treat non-small...
items.titleZh: 美国公司ArriVent股价暴跌，凸显中国生物技术全球化扩张风险
items.summaryZh: 美国生物制药公司ArriVent因其从中国引进的抗癌药物在三期临床试验中失败，导致股价暴跌近47%。这一挫折凸显了中国生物技术公司在海外市场扩张时面临的研发与合规挑战。
items.whyImportant: 该事件揭示了中国生物医药企业在国际化进程中，依赖海外合作伙伴进行临床试验所面临的潜在风险。

items.title: EU negotiators head to China hoping to curb cheap imports of hybrid electric cars
items.summary: Mood in trade talks said to have changed as EU member states harden demands for protection against Chinese imports EU trade negotiators are heading to China for two days of crunch talks aimed at sealing a breakthrough deal tackling Beijing’s record £1bn-a-day trade surplus by curbing its exports of cheap hybrid electric cars into Europe. Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday. items.titleZh: 欧盟谈判代表赴华，旨在限制廉价混合动力汽车进口
items.summaryZh: 欧盟贸易代表团将前往中国进行关键谈判，试图通过限制中国廉价混合动力汽车的进口来缓解贸易失衡。欧盟成员国对保护本土产业的需求日益强烈，谈判过程预计将非常艰难。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了欧盟在绿色转型过程中，对中国电动汽车产业竞争力的防御性贸易政策调整。

items.title: Chinese woman snaps up nearly 200 parking spaces to flip to neighbours for profit
items.summary: A woman in central China invested 14 million yuan (US$2 million) to acquire 196 parking spaces in a residential community, later selling them at a significant mark-up, which led to furious residents suing her. The lawsuit centred around a residential block, the name of which was not disclosed, located in Changsha, Hunan province. The property project was completed and put on the market in 2018. At the time, many were sceptical about the community’s prospects due to a lack of essential public...
items.titleZh: 中国女子买下近200个停车位转手倒卖获利，引发邻居诉讼
items.summaryZh: 湖南长沙一名女子斥资1400万元买下小区内196个停车位，随后高价转卖给邻居，引发业主不满并提起诉讼。该事件源于业主对停车位资源被垄断及价格大幅上涨的抗议。
items.whyImportant: 该案例反映了房地产配套设施经营中的法律与道德争议，以及公众对民生资源被资本垄断的敏感度。

items.title: Empowering a sustainable future: International Gas Union summit to be held in Hong Kong this October
items.summary: [The content of this article has been produced by our advertising partner.] Against a backdrop of persistent geopolitical uncertainties, global energy price trends and energy security have returned firmly to the spotlight. Taking place in Hong Kong late this month, the International Gas Union (IGU) Council 2026 and the “Empowering a Sustainable Future” Summit will offer an essential platform for cross-sector leaders to exchange perspectives on these pressing challenges. Hosted by The Hong Kong...
items.titleZh: 赋能可持续未来：国际燃气联盟峰会将于十月在香港举行
items.summaryZh: 国际燃气联盟（IGU）理事会及“赋能可持续未来”峰会将于本月在香港召开。会议将汇集跨行业领袖，共同探讨地缘政治不确定性背景下的全球能源价格趋势与能源安全问题。
items.whyImportant: 此次峰会为全球能源行业提供了一个交流平台，有助于应对当前复杂的能源供应与安全挑战。

items.title: Trump says Iran could ‘take out’ Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing backlash
items.summary: US President Donald Trump suggested to a crowd of his supporters in Nebraska that Iran could “take out” a major US city like Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing a swift rebuke from California’s Democratic leaders and some fellow Republicans. items.titleZh: 特朗普称伊朗可能“摧毁”洛杉矶或圣地亚哥，引发强烈反弹
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在内布拉斯加州的集会上暗示，伊朗有能力“摧毁”洛杉矶或圣地亚哥等美国大城市。此番言论遭到加州民主党领导人及部分共和党人的迅速批评。
items.whyImportant: 特朗普的言论引发了关于国家安全叙事与政治修辞边界的激烈争议，并加剧了国内政治分歧。

Russian authorities denied that they were imposing anti-plague measures and played down the reports of an incident at a plague research institute in Siberia’s Irkutsk region last week. But Washington is showing growing concern, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio...
items.titleZh: 一名俄罗斯实验室技术员死亡后，美国和世卫组织向莫斯科施压要求说明鼠疫情况
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普表示将就一名俄罗斯实验室技术员死于鼠疫的报道与普京沟通，美方及联合国呼吁莫斯科保持透明。尽管俄方否认在西伯利亚鼠疫研究机构采取了防疫措施并淡化了相关报道，但美国政府对此表示高度关切。

items.summary: US authorities arrested ⁠a person in Washington state on Tuesday ⁠who they accuse of providing advice and offering to live-stream a deadly mass shooting carried out earlier this year in Canada. James Cody Bryant, 30, was detained on a charge of conspiracy to murder people in a foreign country in connection to the shooting at ‌Tumbler Ridge, according to the Department of Justice. The charge carries a penalty of up to life in prison. Bryant was in repeated contact with the shooter, Jesse Van...
items.titleZh: 一名美国公民因涉嫌参与加拿大校园枪击案被捕
items.summaryZh: 美国当局在华盛顿州逮捕了一名30岁男子詹姆斯·科迪·布莱恩特，指控其为今年早些时候发生在加拿大的一起致命校园枪击案提供建议并提议进行直播。布莱恩特面临共谋在外国谋杀的指控，若罪名成立最高可判处终身监禁。
items.whyImportant: 该案凸显了跨境协助暴力犯罪的法律追责难度及国际执法合作的重要性。

items.title: US firm to make battle-tested drones in Taiwan, boosting supply chain resilience
items.summary: Two combat-tested American drones could become part of Taiwan’s expanding unmanned arsenal as the island seeks to build a “drone shield” against the People’s Liberation Army. California-based defence technology company Aevex Aerospace is working with Taiwan’s Coretronic Intelligent Robotics Corporation (CIRC) to produce its Vandal and Onyx drones locally, combining lessons drawn from the war in Ukraine with the island’s electronics and manufacturing capabilities. items.titleZh: 美国公司将在台湾生产实战检验过的无人机，以增强供应链韧性
items.summaryZh: 美国防务公司Aevex Aerospace正与台湾核心智动合作，在台生产Vandal和Onyx无人机。此举旨在结合乌克兰战争的实战经验与台湾的电子制造能力，以构建针对解放军的“无人机盾牌”。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美台在军事供应链领域的深度整合，旨在提升台湾应对潜在军事威胁的防御能力。

items.title: In Islamabad, Guterres calls for end to US-Iran conflict
items.summary: The UN Secretary-General appealed on Tuesday for an end to the United States-Iran war and the toll it has taken on global trade, as he began an official visit to Pakistan.
items.titleZh: 古特雷斯在伊斯兰堡呼吁结束美伊冲突
items.summaryZh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在开启巴基斯坦访问行程时发表讲话，呼吁结束美国与伊朗之间的战争。他强调了这场冲突对全球贸易造成的严重负面影响。
items.whyImportant: 联合国最高官员的表态反映了国际社会对美伊冲突升级及其全球经济后果的深切忧虑。

items.title: Badenoch denies plan for ‘British Iron Dome’ – after Tories use phrase in press release

items.titleZh: 巴德诺赫否认存在“英国铁穹”计划——尽管保守党在新闻稿中使用了该词

items.whyImportant: 此争议反映了英国政坛在国防政策宣传与实际军事规划之间的沟通矛盾。

items.title: Friends of Nolan Wells sue NFL Hall of Famer Terrell Owens for defamation

items.titleZh: 诺兰·威尔斯的朋友起诉NFL名人堂成员特雷尔·欧文斯诽谤

items.titleZh: 马来西亚的缅甸赌注？遣返行动为外交铺路
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚在缅甸领导人到访前遣返缅甸国民，此举被视为东盟国家寻求改善与缅甸军政府关系的最新尝试。分析人士指出，这种双边接触的增加引发了外界对东盟结束缅甸内战努力可能被削弱的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示出东盟内部在处理缅甸危机时，正从集体施压转向更复杂的双边外交博弈。
